summary: react-fast-refresh-helper postinstall drops and executes remote keylogger binary
details: This package impersonates a Meta Open Source React fast-refresh utility but ships an empty index.js (module.exports = {}) and a postinstall hook that runs install.js. On install, install.js downloads a Windows executable from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dunals/kl/main/keylogger.exe (an unrelated personal GitHub repo), writes it to the OS temp directory under a cover-story name of the shape chrome_<timestamp>.exe, marks it executable, and spawns it detached with stdio ignored. The fetched filename in the source repository is keylogger.exe and there is no hash or signature verification. Installing the package causes attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's machine with the user's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
